raw_html: [[Flaming Burst#Flaming Burst|Flaming Burst]][[File:Icon tooltip.png|link=|super|10px]]'''[[Flaming Burst#Flaming Burst|Flaming Burst]]:''' This weapon is sheathed in fire, and deals 1 to 6 fire damage each hit. Critical hits deal an additional 1 to 10 fire damage for weapons with a x2 critical multiplier, 2 to 20 for a x3 multiplier and 3 to 30 for a x4 multiplier.
